pages.title: Hotel Miramar | Stay by the sea
blocks: Welcome to
. Sea air, late breakfasts and no reason to check your watch.
Our seahorse crest has welcomed guests for three generations. Terrace service runs from breakfast until eleven in the evening.
Double rooms from £120. Ask about our midweek rates and private dining room.
pages.snippet: Rooms, terrace dining and private events overlooking the coast.

pages.title: The Mariner | Harbour accommodation
blocks: offers comfortable rooms above the old harbour. Our brass seahorse sign marks the entrance on Quay Street.
Breakfast is served from seven. The residents' lounge is available for small meetings and family celebrations.
Our bar quiz returns on Thursday. The answer is not always "the harbour".
pages.snippet: A family-run hotel beside the old harbour. Look for our brass seahorse.

pages.title: Coral Crown Hotel | Coast and comfort
blocks: Make yourself at home at
. Our seahorse crest is a familiar sight on the eastern promenade.
Family suites, indoor swimming pool and private dining. Dogs welcome. Seagulls will be asked to leave.
pages.snippet: A seaside resort with family suites, a heated pool and our familiar seahorse crest.

pages.title: Open Skies Foundation
blocks: supports local projects through training, grants and regional partnerships.
The swallow in our emblem represents movement, cooperation and a place to return to.
Registration is open for the next
. Regional coordinators will meet for workshops and an evening reception.
pages.snippet: Regional partnerships, community projects and the New Horizons programme.

blocks: 09:00 Registration and coffee. 10:00 Regional reports. 12:30 Lunch. 14:00 Community funding workshops. 18:30 Coordinators' reception.
Delegates receive orange passes at registration. Speakers and volunteers collect grey passes from the information desk.

The Bellini Room hosted the afternoon workshops. Dinner was served on the west terrace, with music from the Harbour Quartet.
Thank you to the delegates, speakers and our events team for a memorable evening.
pages.snippet: Open Skies delegates joined us for workshops, dinner and an evening on the terrace.

pages.title: Meetings & private events | Miramar
blocks: The Bellini Room seats eighty delegates. Smaller groups can reserve the library or west terrace.
Recent guests include the
and the Coastline Business Forum.
Contact our events team for menus, seating plans and group rates.
pages.snippet: Meeting rooms, terrace receptions and private dining for up to eighty guests.

pages.title: What's on | The Mariner
blocks: Thursday: Harbour Quiz, 19:30. Friday: acoustic music from the Quay Street Trio.
Saturday afternoon: the Harbour Accountants Association hosts its annual lunch. Please book your place with the association secretary.
pages.snippet: Quiz nights, harbour history talks and live music in the lounge.

pages.title: Functions | Coral Crown
blocks: Our ballroom is available for weddings and private functions.
This month we welcome the Coastal Garden Society for its spring dinner and the junior sailing club for its awards ceremony.
pages.snippet: Weddings, anniversaries and the Coastal Garden Society spring dinner.

pages.title: Green checks are having a moment
blocks: The return of green checks
A
works just as well with a plain white T-shirt as it does with a matching skirt. This season’s versions favour a relaxed shoulder and contrasting pocket trim.
Choose one strong pattern and keep the rest simple. For evening wear, add a silk scarf or a narrow belt.
Our editor favours dark green checks with brass buttons. Dry-clean only, unless you were hoping to buy a smaller jacket.
pages.snippet: The country-club classic returns, with softer tailoring and brighter accessories.

pages.title: Swallow Watch | Coastal birdwatching club
blocks: Early starts. Sensible shoes. Unreasonable enthusiasm for distant dots.
Our swallow emblem appears on club badges and the cover of our quarterly field journal.
Saturday walk: meet at the east marsh car park at 06:30. Bring binoculars and a flask. The birds have declined to provide a schedule.
pages.snippet: Guided walks, migration notes and a swallow badge for members.

pages.title: Swiftwing Couriers | Same-day delivery
blocks: Local parcels, business documents and same-day deliveries.
Look for the blue swallow on our vans. Our refreshed emblem keeps the familiar wings and adds a brighter background.
Please attach a delivery address. “You know, the building near the other building” remains outside our service guarantee.
pages.snippet: Business deliveries and local parcels. Look for the blue swallow.

pages.title: Volunteers build stronger local partnerships
blocks: , West Region coordinator at Open Skies, led a workshop on recruiting and supporting community volunteers.
The session covered induction, safeguarding and the mysterious disappearance of every working marker pen.
Local groups can contact the foundation’s programme office for future training dates.
pages.snippet: Claire Sutton led a practical workshop for local volunteer groups.

pages.title: Small grants, practical results
blocks: presented the North Region’s small-grants programme at the community centre.
Projects included a repair café, a neighbourhood garden and new equipment for the youth club.
Applications will be reviewed by the regional panel. Biscuits will be reviewed by everyone.
pages.snippet: Nora Bell outlined community funding opportunities in the North Region.

pages.title: Clare Sutton | Ceramics and workshops
blocks: Clare Sutton makes hand-thrown stoneware from a small studio on Market Lane.
Weekend workshops cover bowls, glazing and accepting that your first mug may resemble an ashtray.
Studio visits by appointment. Wholesale enquiries welcome.
pages.snippet: Clare Sutton: handmade stoneware, studio visits and pottery classes.

pages.title: Norah Bell | Piano lessons
blocks: Norah Bell offers individual piano lessons for beginners and returning players.
Evening appointments are available at the Riverside teaching studio.
Patient tuition. The metronome is less patient.
pages.snippet: Norah Bell offers piano tuition and accompaniment services.
